data.name: スローライフサバイバー／SlowLife Survivor
data.detailed_description:
Like has come to a deserted island to live a second life.

You can fight and survive, fish, and live a slow life,

You can develop the land, build a village, and go defeat strong enemies! The possibilities are endless!

You can also run away! Start with what you can do.

Cheating is fine, so we recommend changing jobs from the start!

You'll encounter weak enemies that you can defeat in various places, as well as strong enemies that are currently impossible to defeat.

You can also create items and aim for drops.

This is a free-spirited open-world deserted island survival game!

This game does not have a scenario.

This will be a series, but the first installment will be more of a hack-and-slash RPG!

It may be a game where you enjoy survival and, in the process, defeat strong opponents.

It's a slow-paced game, but there's no romance this time around. Instead, enjoy new discoveries as you watch characters grow, find hidden, powerful enemies, and defeat them over and over again.

Defeat the truly powerful final boss in the Paladin's Labyrinth!

The protagonist, Like, has more starting skills, and they're all unlocked!

(So maybe taking on formidable foes with just Like...maybe!?)

You can now recruit 18 characters!

The number of skills has increased dramatically!

Random encounters have been removed from the early maps, up until village building.

All bosses are symbols. There are some with symbols. But that's really just the early stages.

Perfect for when you want to take it easy and explore a deserted island while listening to the background music!

And what's more! When you set out on the Pirate Seas, you'll find the Paladin's Labyrinth in the middle!

It's a random dungeon. It's open-world, but if you get bored of that, just jump around randomly and

defeat the boss at the very back! There are two bosses: "Paladin" and "True★Paladin"! Which one will you end up with?

To recruit people, you create a village and can choose from 18 people.

◆Guidelines for Testimonials and Reviews

Posting is OK. In fact, we encourage it.

We absolutely prohibit any actions that damage our brand, slander, or otherwise lead to a decrease in sales.

As we're an indie company, there will be some hits and misses. We apologize for this, but we appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

◆Guidelines for Live Commentary

Please feel free to commentate. It's very welcome.

Revenue-generating commentary is also OK. However, please be sure to follow the rules below.

Abusive comments (such as pointing out only negative aspects to make people laugh, streamer comments, or listener comments) are not allowed.

We will take appropriate action against anyone who violates the rules.

We will request removal or report the user.

Please be sure to observe common sense and good manners.
